Description

Educational amateur CubeSat mission providing digital store and forward amateur service to HAM community.

For education purpose, mission collects data related to space environment using sensors without interfering RF communication and disseminates to amateur radio community without any encryption. JNANAM mission provides hands-on training to the students and faculty for development of amateur satellite and its operations.
